name: Illumination Toolbox
author: James Arrowood (Arrowood Industries)
description: Links this player to your Illumination Toolbox account and sends its configuration - channel outputs, pixel strings, schedule, playlists, settings and current warnings - so the xLights AI and the other toolbox tools can see it when you ask for help. Passwords, keys and tokens are redacted on the player before anything leaves it.

privacy.summary: Sends this player's configuration, with passwords removed, to your Illumination Toolbox account, and carries out the requests you make there.

sends.what: this player's settings, outputs, schedule, playlists, file list and warnings
sends.why: so the toolbox and its xLights AI can see how your show is set up

sends.what: requests for work and the results of the ones it ran
sends.why: so you can ask the player for a snapshot or a light test from the toolbox

systemChanges.what: a systemd timer that checks for configuration changes every five minutes, and a service that asks the toolbox for requests

privacy.other: Nothing is sent until you link the player with a code from your toolbox account. Once linked, the account's owner can ask this player through the toolbox for a fresh snapshot, a light test on a channel range, or an fppd restart; untick the remote requests box on the plugin's page to turn that off. Linking stores a device token on the player, which Unlink and uninstall remove.
